title: Доклад об особенностях климата на территории Российской Федерации за 2024 год
organization: Federal Service for Hydrometeorology and Environmental Monitoring (Roshydromet)
temporal_coverage: Climate monitoring for 2024; permafrost active-layer trends for 2005–2024; crop precipitation anomalies relative to 1991–2020.
methodology: Official national climate-monitoring report using station observations, regional aggregates, and permafrost monitoring sites.
limitations: The report does not attribute individual weather events to climate change; permafrost monitoring covers few sites and uneven time series.

title: State Report on the Protection of the Population and Territories of the Russian Federation from Natural and Technogenic Emergencies in 2024
organization: Ministry of the Russian Federation for Civil Defence, Emergencies and Elimination of Consequences of Natural Disasters (EMERCOM)
temporal_coverage: Emergency preparedness, disaster response and impacts recorded in 2024.
methodology: Annual national government report compiling regional emergency preparedness, incident records and response operations.
limitations: Administrative and operational reporting; the cited wildfire and flood-preparedness passages do not assess climate attribution.

title: Second Nationally Determined Contribution of the Russian Federation as part of the implementation of the Paris Agreement
temporal_coverage: Government submission in 2025; includes warming observations since the mid-1970s and adaptation arrangements through 2025.
methodology: Government submission summarizing observed trends, adaptation plans and selected practices.
limitations: Self-reported policies; second-stage plan ended in 2025 and later status was not checked.

title: Heuristic relative assessment of climate risks in Russian regions
organization: Higher School of Economics; article published in Science of the Total Environment
temporal_coverage: Current exposure and vulnerability indicators with climate-hazard projections to mid-century under multiple SSP scenarios.
methodology: Publisher abstract describes heuristic regional risk ranking using hazard, exposure and vulnerability indicators.
limitations: Full article was not inspected; the abstract notes incomplete spatial economic data and no quantified damage functions.

title: Adapting to what? Regional climate policy in Russia
organization: Fridtjof Nansen Institute; article published in Energy Policy
temporal_coverage: Regional adaptation policies analyzed in an article published online 17 April 2026.
methodology: Publisher abstract summarizes regional climate adaptation policies, including Yamal-Nenets.
limitations: Only the publisher abstract was inspected; no independent outcome evaluation.

title: Climate risks
temporal_coverage: Bank of Russia climate-risk analysis, stress tests and financial-institution survey reported through 2024; one modeled horizon is 2030–2040.
methodology: Official central-bank page summarizing climate-risk analysis, stress tests and a survey of financial institutions.
limitations: Underlying stress-test and survey reports were not reviewed; the 2030–2040 transition-risk estimates are described as preliminary.
